title: Power Rangers Season 28 Dino Fury
description: When an army of powerful alien beings is unleashed on Earth threatening life as we know it, a brand-new team of Power Rangers, fueled by the prehistoric power of the dinosaurs, are recruited to deal with the threat.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x1
episodes_data.description: Reporter Amelia accompanies Ollie and his mom, Dr. Akana, to investigate the mysterious Dinohenge statues; the trio run into an evil warrior named Void Knight and a threat that puts the entire world in danger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x2
episodes_data.description: Ollie carries out a plan to catch Sporix without his teammates' knowledge; Ollie realizes the benefit of working as a team.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x3
episodes_data.description: The Rangers intercept a mysterious message from outer space and Zayto is desperate to know if it was sent from his home planet; unable to decipher the message and losing hope, Zayto remembers another important message from the past.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x4
episodes_data.description: General Boomtower tries to steal a mysterious orb from the city museum; when the Rangers struggle to stop him, they get help from an unexpected source.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x5
episodes_data.description: Izzy is determined to win a big race with the help of her Special Olympics athlete cousin, Lily; after Lily misses a training session and Izzy rejects more help, her sportsmanship is put to the test.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x6
episodes_data.description: Amelia thinks she's cursed with bad luck and is reluctant to help the Rangers, afraid she'll cause more harm; Amelia learns the truth about luck when monsters attack the base.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x7
episodes_data.description: The Warden takes away Javi's keytar, putting him in a bad mood, which he refuses to explain to the team. Javi is forced to open up about his problems in order to find his Zord.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x8
episodes_data.description: A familiar face arrives on Earth and Zayto dismisses his quest as a distraction; after he saves the Rangers from a powerful Sporix Beast, Zayto realizes an important lesson.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x9
episodes_data.description: The Rangers tease Ollie for bringing all of his gadgets on a camping trip. But his tech might be their only hope when sinister Sporix suddenly attack.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x10
episodes_data.description: A knight from Zayto's home planet suddenly appears at Dinohedge with a message that might be too good to be true... and Solon has her suspicions.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x11
episodes_data.description: Amelia hunts for ghosts at a creepy mansion. But there's no supernatural sighting -- only a fierce face-off with pyramid-shaped Tombtress.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x12
episodes_data.description: Izzy is convinced a new coach is going to take her athletics to the next level. However, her training aspirations are put to the test when she discovers the coach's true motivations

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x13
episodes_data.description: Javi thinks Izzy has a crush on a friend and he sets them up on a date, but his assumption causes big problems when the monsters smell love in the air.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x14
episodes_data.description: Ollie boasts to his friends that he's afraid of nothing. But when the other Dino Fury Rangers are captured by a formidable foe, Ollie realizes his biggest fear.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x15
episodes_data.description: Ollie agrees to help Javi with a story, but his desire for new tech distracts him from his promise. The villains exploit his obsession, and Ollie learns a lesson about priorities.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x16
episodes_data.description: Aiyon, the new Gold Ranger, reveals the dark truth about Zayto's past and the Dino Fury Rangers learn what makes a true leader.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x17
episodes_data.description: Getting a free ice cream for a heroic act goes to Aiyon's head. But later on, when his Zord is captured, he learns what it means to be a true hero.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x18
episodes_data.description: Izzy attempts to hide her struggles in electronics class put the Rangers at risk when they need those skills during a battle.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x19
episodes_data.description: The villains use a Sporix Beast with body-swapping powers to chase pirate treasure, interrupting Amelia's attempts to make over Pop-Pop for a date.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x20
episodes_data.description: Zayto is trapped on a distant planet seeking new Zords, and Aiyon makes a risky trip to save him. Together, they confront the nightmares of their past.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x21
episodes_data.description: The Rangers need Dr. Akana's help to stop Void Knight's evil scheme. But Ollie disagrees with Zayto's plan, afraid it will put his mother in danger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury 28x22
episodes_data.description: While the Rangers fight to get Santa's magic sketchbook back from the villains, Javi and Solon are caught in a trap. Will they escape?
